monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC’s Black Friday 2026 Is Now Live: Win an iPad Air and Unlock Exclusive Savings JLCCNC’s Black Friday 2026 Is Now Live: Win an iPad Air and Unlock Exclusive Savings Events Nov 18, 2026 Table of Contents Mark Your Calendar Explore the Black Friday 2026 Offers BUILD MORE, PAY LESS. JLC Technology Group's Black Friday 2026 officially starts today, and runs through December 2 (ET). Following the warm-up campaign, the official sale brings more opportunities to save on electronics and mechanical manufacturing. Customers can enter a lucky draw by placing an order or sharing the campaign, claim exclusive coupons across multiple services, and access limited-quantity flash deals released daily. Whether you need CNC machining or sheet metal fabrication, or are sourcing complementary PCB fabrication, assembly, 3D printing and mechanical components, offers are available across JLCCNC, JLCPCB, JLC3DP and JLCMC to help reduce eligible project costs. Black Friday Lucky Draw: Order or Share to Win The Black Friday lucky draw is now open, with Apple iPad Air among the prizes. By placing an order or sharing the campaign, eligible customers can earn up to two spins per account. Prizes include: Apple iPad Air $100 Amazon Gift Cards SMT Stencil Printers Development Boards Exclusive discount coupons, including up to 30% OFF coupons and additional order discounts How to Earn Spins: Customers with previous JLC Technology Group order records receive one spin. First-time customers can earn one spin after placing and paying for an order<dynamic-value> the Black Friday campaign on social media to earn one additional spin. Each account can receive a maximum of two spins. Coupon prizes will be credited to the winner’s account automatically. Winners of physical prizes will be contacted within one month after the event ends. Exclusive Black Friday Coupons Across Our Services The sale brings together service-specific discounts for electronics and mechanical manufacturing. Customers can choose offers according to the services and production needs of their projects. Here is a breakdown of the available offers: JLCCNC : Up to $135 in combined coupon value for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication. JLCPCB : Up to $251 in combined coupon value across PCB, PCBA, FPC, Layout, stencil, and other services. JLC3DP : Up to $47 in combined coupon value for resin, nylon, metal, and engineering plastic 3D printing. JLCMC : Up to 10% OFF Selected Mechanical Components, Plus a $10 OFF Shipping Coupon. JLCONE : Exclusive $15 OFF prototype coupons, and $30 OFF batch order coupons. EasyEDA : $15 OFF PCB orders. From prototypes to small-batch production orders, these offers provide different ways to reduce costs across PCB design, fabrication, assembly, and mechanical manufacturing. Flash Deals & Flash Coupons: New Offers Every Day Alongside the regular coupon offers, the Black Friday sale features limited-time product deals and additional discount coupons. New quantities are released daily at 10:00 AM ET . Offers are available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last, with quantities refreshed every day. Once the available quantity is gone, customers will need to check the next release for another opportunity. Check the campaign page regularly to see current deals, upcoming offers, and available coupon quantities.
